19. 圖中，ABCD 為一圓。AC 與 BD 相交於 E。若 AB = AD 及 AD // BC，則 ∠BAE =

A. 53° 。
B. 57° 。
C. 69° 。
D. 74° 。
reasoning: Let $\angle ADB = x$. Since $AB = AD$, $\angle ABD = \angle ADB = x$. Since $AD // BC$, $\angle DBC = \angle ADB = x$ (alternate angles). In the circle, $\angle DAC = \angle DBC = x$ and $\angle ACB = \angle ADB = x$ (angles in the same segment). From the diagram, $\angle DEC = 74^\circ$, so its vertically opposite angle $\angle AEB = 74^\circ$ and the adjacent angle $\angle BEC = 180^\circ - 74^\circ = 106^\circ$. In $\triangle EBC$, the sum of angles is $180^\circ$, so $x + x + 106^\circ = 180^\circ \implies 2x = 74^\circ \implies x = 37^\circ$. Finally, in $\triangle ABE$, $\angle BAE + \angle ABE + \angle AEB = 180^\circ \implies \angle BAE + 37^\circ + 74^\circ = 180^\circ \implies \angle BAE = 180^\circ - 111^\circ = 69^\circ$.
